findings.verifierReasoning: The source clause does not permit general Indebtedness up to the cap. It permits only "Indebtedness incurred in connection with or in substitution or replacement of a Receivables Transfer Program" up to the cap. That RTP-connection requirement is an independently operative condition defining which debt qualifies for the basket. The proposed IR omits it entirely and therefore would treat any Indebtedness up to the greater of $125,000,000 and 7.5% of Consolidated Total Assets as permitted, even if completely unrelated to a Receivables Transfer Program. A hypothetical transaction of $100,000,000 of ordinary unsecured debt unrelated to any RTP would be prohibited under the source (unless permitted under another clause) but would be permitted under the proposed IR. This is a material scope/condition discrepancy, and the COMPLETE sufficiency claim is therefore inaccurate.
